articles.title: Team USA members basking in gold medal, ready for Frozen Frenzy
Lightning recall G Mads Sogaard  from AHL Syracuse
Feisty Grubauer, Kraken Battle To Another Road Win

away.summary: The Kraken are riding a strong offensive start, ranking 2nd in the league in goals per game (4.33) and featuring offensive balance with 12 forwards having at least three points. They are coming off a 3-2 shootout win over the Flyers, improving to 5-2-0 on a five-city road trip. Philipp Grubauer is projected to start in net, with Curtis Douglas and Cale Fleury scratched, and Jacob Melanson and Ryan Lindgren out with upper-body injuries.

out.detail: scratched (recalled but not expected to dress)

home.summary: The Lightning are 4-1-0 and projected to start Andrei Vasilevskiy in net for this game. They have recalled Mads Sogaard from the AHL, but he is not expected to dress, with Scott Sabourin scratched and replaced by Jeff Viel. Yanni Gourde (hip) and Emil Lilleberg (upper body) are injured. The team features a top line of Gage Goncalves, Brayden Point, and Nikita Kucherov, with defensive stability from Victor Hedman and Erik Cernak.
